messages:
tara: Anyone seen the black whiteboard marker? Last spotted on the 2nd-floor collab table this morning.
leo: I grabbed a blue yesterday but the black was missing when I checked.
sam: I noticed a weird post-it pile near the plant shelf earlier :eyes: maybe it fell in there?
mohit: Not me. Marker stewardship policy: if you borrow it, return it. Also mandatory snack bribe accepted. :grin: 
tara: Alright, marker bounty declared — whoever returns it gets a donut from me. :doughnut:
marker-bot: Inventory update: whiteboard markers — black: 1, red: 0, blue: 3. (auto-check at 10:02)
sam: Donut incentive activated. 
leo: I'll do a sweep under chairs + table.
mohit: Quick poll: want a permanent marker stash in the kitchen? React with :white_check_mark: for yes, :x: for no.
sam: :white_check_mark:
leo: :white_check_mark: also vote for more snacks pls
tara: Found it! It was under a stack of post-its by the standing desk. Praise be. :raised_hands:
mohit: Photo or it didn't happen.
leo: Proof or donut.
tara: tara: [image: black-marker-under-postits.jpg] — here's the culprit. Donut fund intact.
sam: Legendary recovery. Thanks tara! :trophy:
mohit: Marker returned, office harmony restored. Also I'll add a spare set to the kitchen stash tomorrow.
marker-bot: Closing thread: marker status now black: 2, red: 0, blue: 3. Reminder scheduled: weekly marker check every Monday at 09:00.
